meta.name: linkedin-marketing
meta.description: Plan, draft, audit, and publish LinkedIn posts and comments. Use when the user wants to write a viral LinkedIn post, draft a comment or reply on any LinkedIn post URL, audit a draft against 2026 algorithm heuristics, remove AI tells, extract hook formulas from viral posts, or plan a week of content. Powered by the Publora API for publishing. User provides post/comment URLs, skill drafts content, user approves, then publishes.
